original_body: 将脑组织置于含抗β-III Tubulin（TUJ1）兔多克隆抗体（1:500稀释于封闭液）的溶液中，轻柔振荡孵育。

original_body: 用PBST洗涤，去除未结合二抗。

english_body_original_metadata: Perform a final wash with 1× PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 min)

original_body: 将脑组织置于50% (vol/vol) THF（四氢呋喃）水溶液（用NaOH调pH至9–10，以保护荧光蛋白）中振荡脱水。

source.text: 将脑组织置于70% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（pH 9–10）中振荡脱水。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

original_body: 将脑组织置于70% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（pH 9–10）中振荡脱水。

original_body: 将脑组织置于80% (vol/vol) THF水溶液（pH 9–10）中振荡脱水。

source.text: 将脑组织置于100% THF（无水，pH 9–10，加少量NaOH）中振荡脱水，第一次。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

source.text: 将脑组织置于100% THF（无水，pH 9–10）中振荡脱水，第二次（更换新鲜THF）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

english_body_original_metadata: Place the brain tissue in 100% THF (anhydrous, pH 9–10), and dehydrate with shaking for the second time (replacing with fresh THF).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
original_body: 将脑组织置于100% THF（无水，pH 9–10）中振荡脱水，第二次（更换新鲜THF）。

source.text: 将脑组织置于BABB（苯甲醇:苯甲酸苄酯 = 1:2, vol/vol）中振荡，完成脱脂并开始RI匹配，直至组织完全透明（通常30–60 min）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)

english_body_original_metadata: Place the brain tissue in BABB (benzyl alcohol:benzyl benzoate = 1:2, vol/vol) with shaking to complete delipidation and begin RI matching, until completely transparent (usually 30–60 min).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 1 hour)
original_body: 将脑组织置于BABB（苯甲醇:苯甲酸苄酯 = 1:2, vol/vol）中振荡，完成脱脂并开始RI匹配，直至组织完全透明（通常30–60 min）。

source.text: 将透明脑组织转移至新鲜BABB（RI ≈ 1.56）中，避光静置平衡，确保组织完全透明且无气泡。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

english_body_original_metadata: Transfer the transparent brain tissue into fresh BABB (RI ≈ 1.56) and let equilibrate without agitation, protected from light, ensuring that the tissue is completely transparent and free of bubbles.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 2 hours)
original_body: 将透明脑组织转移至新鲜BABB（RI ≈ 1.56）中，避光静置平衡，确保组织完全透明且无气泡。

source.text: 再次更换新鲜BABB，确认组织完全透明，准备成像。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 30 min)

english_body_original_metadata: Replace with fresh BABB again, confirm complete tissue transparency, and prepare for imaging.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 30 min)

source.text: 将透明脑组织转移至适配光片显微镜样品槽的BABB中，使用折射率匹配的浸没介质（RI = 1.56）固定样品位置，避免气泡。(Temperature: RT, Time: 即刻成像)

english_body_original_metadata: Transfer the transparent brain tissue into BABB in a light-sheet microscope sample chamber, use a refractive-index-matched immersion medium (RI = 1.56) to secure the sample position, and avoid bubbles.(Temperature: RT, Time: 即刻成像)
original_body: 将透明脑组织转移至适配光片显微镜样品槽的BABB中，使用折射率匹配的浸没介质（RI = 1.56）固定样品位置，避免气泡。

source.text: 若需短期保存，将样品密封于BABB中，避光、4 ℃保存（建议1周内完成成像，以防荧光信号衰减）。(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ≤ 7 days)

english_body_original_metadata: If short-term storage is needed, seal the sample in BABB and store at 4 ℃ protected from light (imaging within 1 week is recommended to avoid fluorescent signal decay).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ≤ 7 days)
original_body: 若需短期保存，将样品密封于BABB中，避光、4 ℃保存（建议1周内完成成像，以防荧光信号衰减）。
